input.quote: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
input.rationale: The cap is mutual, indirect damages are mutually excluded and the Excluded Claims set in 21.3 matches our preferred carve-outs (including that payment obligations are not damages). However the cap base is illusory: "Fees" is defined in 1.5/1.6 as only the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the ceiling is far below six months' actual spend — walk-away territory. Redline changes the basis to the greater of all amounts paid or payable in the preceding 12 months and USD 1,000,000.

input.quote: If any invoice is not paid within ten days of its due date, Customer shall pay Vendor, as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to fifteen percent of the annual Fees for each week the invoice remains unpaid.
input.rationale: Section 7.7 imposes liquidated damages on Customer accruing weekly at 15% of annual Fees, triggered by a ten-day delay — a penalty running against us and outside even the fallback (a single early-termination fee capped at 3 months' fees). Redline replaces it with customary late interest on undisputed amounts.
